name: user-interface
description: Front door for interface design: terminal and CLI output, TUIs, prompt themes, Claude Code mods, web and app UI. design detects the project's own design system and the design tools installed, routes each concern to the best present source with the project first, and supplies its own guidance where nothing covers the concern. Terminal guidance is its own contribution.

account_tools_enabled.title: Account-bound tools
account_tools_enabled.description: Route to tools that need an account, login or API key (Claude Design, Figma, axe) when installed and reachable; false uses only account-free tools. Paid tools only when nothing free fits. Only Claude Design (interactive sessions) is tested; the rest stay deferred.

css_browser_target.title: CSS browser target
css_browser_target.description: Browserslist query for the browsers CSS must support when the project has no browserslist config, such as "baseline widely available". Empty uses the plugin default. A team or personal convention file overrides it.

css_important.title: CSS !important
css_important.description: When !important is acceptable: avoid (default), utilities-only, or allow. A team or personal convention file overrides it.

css_layer.title: CSS cascade layer
css_layer.description: The cascade layer new CSS goes in. Empty follows the project's own layer order. A team or personal convention file overrides it.

css_token_fallback.title: CSS token fallback
css_token_fallback.description: When no design token matches a value: ask (default), propose-token, or literal. A team or personal convention file overrides it.
